{{Quote|Hearing that TIE roar brings me back to my Navy days.|Jenson Marsh|<ref name="SWG:JtL">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed]]''</ref>}}
'''Jenson Marsh''' was a retired [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[TIE pilot]] that lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
[[File:TemplateCivilian.png|250px|thumb|Possible depictions of Jenson Marsh]]
After his retirement from the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]], Jenson Marsh became a freelancer pilot of the ''[[Fariso]]''. On contract with the [[Research Outpost|Imperial Research Station]] on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]], he delivered important cargo to the [[Space station/Legends|Endor Space Station]] with the help of an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] pilot who escorted him.
